LESSON: GOD’S PLAN FOR REDEMPTION

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: CREATION
Topic 1.2: God’s Plan for Redemption

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on God’s Plan for Redemption. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is God’s redemptive plan important to human kind?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe how God demonstrated love to humankind after the fall of man
2. explain the importance of redemption after the fall of man
3. appreciate God’s saving grace in their day-to-day life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: GOD’S PLAN FOR REDEMPTION
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 8
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
God’s Plan for Redemption helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: GOD’S PLAN FOR REDEMPTION
Study God’s Plan for Redemption like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Describe how God demonstrated love to humankind after the fall of man

What this means
In this part you learn to describe how God demonstrated love to humankind after the fall of man. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe how God demonstrated love to humankind after the fall of man.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “God’s Plan for Redemption” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe how God demonstrated love to humankind after the fall of man. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Explain the importance of redemption after the fall of man

What this means
In this part you learn to explain the importance of redemption after the fall of man. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain the importance of redemption after the fall of man.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to God’s Plan for Redemption in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain the importance of redemption after the fall of man. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate God’s saving grace in their day-to-day life

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate God’s saving grace in their day-to-day life. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate God’s saving grace in their day-to-day life.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate God’s saving grace in their day-to-day life. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what God’s Plan for Redemption is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “God’s Plan for Redemption” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: describe how God demonstrated love to humankind after the fall of man)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to God’s Plan for Redemption in your own words. (skill: explain the importance of redemption after the fall of man)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: appreciate God’s saving grace in their day-to-day life)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach God’s Plan for Redemption to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: describe how God demonstrated love to humankind after the fall of man.
3. Practise this skill: explain the importance of redemption after the fall of man.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate God’s saving grace in their day-to-day life.
5. Make one local Kenya example of God’s Plan for Redemption from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for God’s Plan for Redemption: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 8 learner study God’s Plan for Redemption?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is God’s redemptive plan important to human kind?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what God’s Plan for Redemption means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: describe how God demonstrated love to humankind after the fall of man.
5. Be able to: explain the importance of redemption after the fall of man.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
